milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The blue_glazed_terracotta is a 2x2 patch on the floor at spawn-relative (-3,0,-3) to (-2,0,-2). Target is the center of that patch rounded to (-2, 0, -2). Player must navigate within 5 blocks and face toward it (facing_tolerance=60) to demonstrate they have located it. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The light_blue_stained_glass wall spans from (-4,0,3) to (4,3,3) spawn-relative. Target is the center of the glass wall at (0, 1, 3). Player must be within 8 blocks and facing toward it (facing_tolerance=60) to demonstrate they have found and are observing the glass wall. max_distance=8 is generous enough to allow detection from most positions inside the 9x9 room.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block') because building a table requires placing blocks. A Minecraft table conventionally consists of oak_fence as legs and oak_slab as the tabletop. Two rules ensure BOTH components are placed: at least 1 oak_fence (leg) and at least 1 oak_slab (top) within the room interior. The box [-4,0,-4] to [4,2,4] covers the full room interior up to 2 blocks high (fence + slab on top). Neither oak_fence nor oak_slab exist in the scene initially, so no false positives are possible.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='oak_planks') because building a ceiling requires placing blocks overhead. The walls are 4 blocks tall (Y+0 to Y+3), so the ceiling sits at Y+4. The check box [-4,4,-4] to [4,4,4] covers the interior at ceiling height only, excluding the wall perimeter at ±5. CRITICAL: The scene was fixed so walls only extend to Y+3, meaning Y+4 is completely empty initially — no false positives. min_count=4 requires at least 4 planks placed to form a recognizable partial ceiling (player has 20 oak_planks available).
